title: 수도방위사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:20732:20080229:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Decree of the Act on Security of the President, etc.) <No. 20732, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (4) Omitted.

(5) The Decree on the Capital Defense Command is partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (2), "Chief of the Presidential Security Office" shall be replaced with "Chief of the Presidential Security Service under the Office of the President".

Article 4 Omitted.
